Ramdev and Brij Bhushan Singh resolve dispute over Patanjali products

Yoga guru Ramdev and former MP Brij Bhushan Singh have resolved a dispute concerning allegations of adulteration in Patanjali products. Ramdev stated that neither Patanjali's ghee nor its medicines are adulterated, asserting that Singh's earlier statements were based on hearsay. Ramdev also challenged critics to prove any impurity in Patanjali products, offering to face public execution if found guilty. Singh reportedly met with Ramdev and offered his respects.
